_doc: Bambu Lab P2S (or X1C/P1S) with a 0.2 mm nozzle, PLA. Print thresholds: walls >= 0.45 mm, pins >= 0.8, barrels >= 1.0, blades >= 1.2, gaps >= 0.3 mm or fused. auto_thicken pushes walls to target_mm; the check stage flags walls under qa.min_thickness_mm that stick out (see flag.thin_part_min_protrusion_mm).
